description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 22.06.2015 to 28.06.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter concerning customs administration and financial compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements.
